A '''planet''' was the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had a [[Unidentified dead red moon|single dead]] [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The moon held a civilization which had been extinct millennia before [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when it was settled by the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]].

Soresh's machinations led to a [[Battle of the Sixela system|battle]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The planet, along with everything else within a few billion [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], were turned into [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and dust when the sun became [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] as a result of Soresh's [[resonance torpedo]]es.<ref name="RF:U" />

==Behind the scenes==
This planet appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''; it was identified early on as being the third planet but later was said to be the sixth.
